_comment: EDIT ME: this list mirrors the FAQ accordion in admissions.html and also feeds the chatbot's FAQ knowledge. Keep both in sync when you add a question here.

faqs.question: What age does my child need to be to enroll?
faqs.answer: We accept children from 6 months of age for our Creche program, up to 11 years for Primary.

faqs.question: Are admissions open throughout the year?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept new students throughout the year, subject to availability of spaces in each class.

faqs.question: Do you offer a trial period or visiting day?
faqs.answer: Yes! We encourage families to schedule a school tour before enrolling so you can see our environment and meet our team.

faqs.question: Are there sibling discounts available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer sibling discounts. Please contact our administrative office for the current discount structure.

faqs.question: Do pupils have to wear a uniform?
faqs.answer: Yes, all pupils wear the Cedarville uniform on regular school days, with a house-colour outfit on designated activity days. Uniforms can be purchased through the school office.

faqs.question: What are the school's operating hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM - 6:00 PM. The Creche program runs on extended hours until 6:00 PM to support working parents.
